observation.command: cd /workspace/project && K="cap_live_2a9c30a47d0bbdfde2f4470b61648b0b"; R=$(curl -s --max-time 30 -X POST https://api.capbypass.pro/createTask -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"clientKey\":\"$K\",\"task\":{\"type\":\"ReCaptchaV3TaskProxyLess\",\"websiteURL\":\"https://recaptcha-demo.appspot.com/recaptcha-v3-request-scores.php\",\"websiteKey\":\"6LdKlZEpAAAAAAOQjzC2v_d36tWxCl6dWsozdSy9\",\"pageAction\":\"homepage\"}}"); TID=$(echo "$R" | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('taskId',''))"); echo "taskId=$TID"; for i in $(seq 1 15); do sleep 2; S=$(curl -s --max-time 25 -X POST https://api.capbypass.pro/getTaskResult -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"clientKey\":\"$K\",\"taskId\":\"$TID\"}"); if echo "$S" | grep -q '"ready"'; then TOK=$(echo "$S" | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['solution']['gRecaptchaResponse'])"); echo "token ok (${#TOK} char)"; echo "$TOK" > /tmp/demo_tok.txt; break; fi; echo "[$i] $(echo $S|head -c 90)"; done
